events.title: Ramsar sites: Sukhna Wetland and Sauj Jheel added
events.subject: Environment
events.hook: The 15 October announcement identifies Sukhna Wetland (Chandigarh) and Sauj Jheel (Uttar Pradesh) as additions, with India's announced total at 103. Treat 103 as the announcement's figure; recheck the Convention's country directory before calling it the current registry count.

source.title: Convention on Wetlands: India adds two sites

events.subject: Economy
events.hook: For people aged 15 and above under Current Weekly Status, the bulletin reports LFPR 55.5%, WPR 52.7% and unemployment rate 5.0%. Keep the age group and survey basis with each figure; compare like periods and note the January 2025 methodology change.

events.title: NSAP continuation and approved scheme changes
events.subject: Polity
events.hook: The Cabinet approved continuation for 2026–27 to 2030–31 with an outlay of ₹53,428 crore. The release also approves changes to disability pension eligibility and assistance; its implementation guidelines were still due within three months, so do not present these changes as already operational.
